nodes.label: Student Task View
nodes.rationale: Stable read-only projection combines task definitions, optional instances, project target grade, tutorial context, prerequisites, and date policy.

nodes.label: Unknown Outcome
nodes.rationale: Non-idempotent operations with unproven server results must not be retried automatically.

nodes.label: Authentication MCP
nodes.rationale: The separate MCP server is deliberately restricted to authentication and never returns credentials or browser authentication data.

nodes.label: Safe Agent Writes
nodes.rationale: Writes are dry-run by default; confirmed writes require stable idempotency keys and unknown results are not redispatched.

nodes.label: Agent-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: Human terminal rendering is optional over the same execution capability that primarily serves agents.

nodes.label: Auth Runtime
nodes.rationale: Centralizes session refresh, expiry handling, 401/419 interpretation, cross-process single-flight, and protected storage.

nodes.label: Five Deep Modules
nodes.rationale: Concentrating behavior behind small interfaces increases caller leverage and localizes rules, defects, and validation.

nodes.label: Auth Lifecycle and Security Identity Module
nodes.norm_label: auth lifecycle and security identity module

nodes.label: Task Planner and Date Semantics Module
nodes.norm_label: task planner and date semantics module

nodes.label: Production Contract Discovery and Fixture Module
nodes.norm_label: production contract discovery and fixture module

nodes.label: CI/CD Pipeline
nodes.rationale: A single verified tarball is built reproducibly, stored as a GitHub Release asset, and optionally published to npm through protected OIDC.

nodes.label: Coverage Ratchet
nodes.rationale: Bun LCOV line and function coverage are enforced at 80% without configured source exclusions.

nodes.label: Production Model Change
nodes.rationale: The student product model has expanded beyond project.tasks, simple task status, synchronous uploads, and static token caching.

nodes.label: Release Procedure
nodes.rationale: Release progression requires an annotated version tag, repeated verification, exactly one checksummed tarball, draft-release validation, and protected-environment approval.
